description: Most recent weekly NASS crop condition ratings for corn, soybeans, or wheat — the share of the crop rated excellent, good, fair, poor, and very poor, plus a combined good+excellent percentage — from USDA NASS QuickStats. Use for current crop health; use get_crop_condition_history instead for week-by-week change across the season, and get_crop_progress for growth-stage pace. Read-only lookup of stored statistics; no API key. Ratings are published weekly in season, but the stored copy refreshes weekly, so the returned `period` (e.g. 2026-W30) is the freshest stored week, not necessarily the current one.

geography.description: US for national, or state code (IA, IL, etc.); state coverage is the major corn-belt states. Default: US

name: get_crop_condition
